metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the forty leaves, the title Seven Days, Navarre in the afternoon, and the parish fire.

yesterday: You looked at the forty leaves. The ruled couplet is still the end.
The Rose's title in the house was Seven Days, by the Lord Admiral his Servants.
You played Navarre to a thin yard. The tally stayed at nineteen lines and a noise like a goose.
The watch was doubled. Mistress Ansell stayed twenty minutes, and Verbeke stayed at the door of the close.
